Domain csproj references nothing (claim 4).

Labelled opinion with a stated condition (read-only endpoint, no rule). Note: the Microsoft architecture guide takes the stricter line - "developers should limit actual references to types in the Infrastructure project to the app's composition root" (line 186) - which the lesson presents as the opposing view in section 6 (claim 12).

Opposing view, conditioned ('pays off when many people add endpoints and rules appear often'); consistent with line 172 of the Microsoft guide: "its types should interact with infrastructure strictly through interfaces defined in Application Core".
